request: Owner, 13 Nov (screenshot of the guides band): «я бы хотел, чтобы иконки стали более такими реалистичными, потому что сейчас ну, нормально, но чуть-чуть… чуточку реалистичнее было бы хорошо». Then, after the first pass went live: «по иконкам не вижу разницы».
model: gpt_image_2_6 (Higgsfield), quality high, 1k, transparent background, 4:3, text only (no reference). The first pass (reference-based, jobs kept under firstPass) stayed too close to the 9 Nov set to be seen at tile size; a second reference-based try with a stronger prompt did the same.
promptTemplate: A real studio product photograph of [concept]. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 100 mm macro lens, three-quarter view from slightly above, centred, the whole object in frame with a little margin. True-to-life proportions and materials: [material cues]. Soft key light from the upper left, soft fill, a realistic soft contact shadow directly under it. Warm palette of cream, terracotta red, deep sage green and brushed brass. It must look like a photograph of real things, not a 3D render, illustration, clay or toy. Fully transparent background with clean edges, no backdrop, no floor, no glow. No text, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, flags, people or hands.
processing: Trimmed, fitted inside 468×(H−12) and centred in the exact old 480×H frames, so no layout moves; WebP q84/alpha92 at 480 and 240. folder-quiet-240 is the new folder at 30% saturation, as before. Reviewed at full size on #2A2420 and #FFFDF9 against the 9 Nov set: same subjects and palette, now photographic — real proportions (a thin stamp handle, normal keys and coins), worn book cloth, a leather doctor’s bag, crumpled banknotes, deckle-edged paper, a steel clipboard clip; the signature is an abstract scribble, banknotes carry guilloche only; no text, numerals, currency symbols, crests, flags or people.
